description: nlmod is a Python package for building, running and inspecting MODFLOW 6 groundwater models. It was developed around publicly available Dutch subsurface data. Its modules construct spatial and temporal grids in xarray, read and project external data, assemble groundwater-flow or transport packages through FloPy, and visualise results in Python or GIS. Inputs are model grids, groundwater parameters and source data; outputs are MODFLOW packages and post-processed simulation fields. Geographic coverage and time resolution follow the selected model, although the provided data connectors focus on the Netherlands. Source is free under MIT terms and documentation is published on Read the Docs. The package still needs MODFLOW 6 and suitable source data; installing it alone does not provide a validated groundwater model. It supports reproducible groundwater and water-supply studies. It can work alongside GSFLOW-related tools, but integration was not tested. No source datasets or model executables were downloaded.
